chunks: Al-Nadr narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Whatever of your prayers you missed due to a period of unconsciousness, make it up when you regain consciousness."

key_terms.اقْضِهِ: make it up / perform the qada

ai.seo_question: How to make up missed prayers after regaining consciousness from illness?
ai.summary: Reported by Al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the ruling for *al-mughama 'alayh* (one who loses consciousness) by mandating the makeup (*qada*) of all missed obligatory prayers upon regaining awareness. This ruling distinguishes the condition from insanity (*junun*), where prayers are not required to be made up, thereby emphasizing the preservation of the prayer obligation during temporary lapses in consciousness.
